ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark-spectrum) pixels across approx. 94% of the visible surface; localized high-intensity (white/light-grey) clusters restricted to distal tips and sparse punctate spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-contrast clusters (white/beige) localized at the extreme distal tips (left and right margins). Secondary sparse white punctate spots distributed randomly across the dark-pigmented central regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approx. 52 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying 1/7th of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the upper boundary; pixel amplitude of peaks varies from 3 to 12 pixels; serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex upward trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips; lower boundary shows a smooth concave curve narrowing towards the central peduncle attachment site.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of irregular high-contrast pixels (barnacle colonization) at both distal tips; smaller isolated circular white clusters detected on the lower mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible white unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the mid-section and trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological growth (barnacles) at distal tips; scattered white scarring/abrasions across the dark surface, particularly on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular step-like notch/serration on the upper edge of the right lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
